D50: consumption=None selects the vessel policy's default 10% remaining per consumable group.
D50: each declared consumable group retains 0.1 of departure contents unless complete explicit consumption replaces it
D50: no voyage ballast operations are declared or permitted.

D57 DECLARATION: proportional draw-down applies to every consumable tank: mass(r) = departure mass * one common remaining fraction r; symmetric pairs drain together. Default arrival r=0.10; explicit group consumption must imply the same r across all nonempty groups.
DECLARATION: absent from supplied tank catalog: lube_oil, stores
UNVERIFIED: berth/channel draught limit is unknown (None), not an assertion of unlimited draught.
